`abstract class MsdfSource`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IMsdfSource`](/reference/text/imsdfsource/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BinaryMsdfSource`](/reference/text/binarymsdfsource/), [`OpenTypeMsdfSource`](/reference/text/opentypemsdfsource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MsdfSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/source/MsdfSource.java)

Base class of the MSDF sources, which can override the weight and the style that the file declares.

## Description

```java fragment
MsdfFontLoader.load(OpenTypeMsdfSource.of("fonts/Logo.ttf").weight(FontWeight.BOLD));
```

## Learn more

- [Custom fonts and MSDF](/use/learn/going-further/fonts/)

## Property details

<a id="MsdfSource-property-italic"></a>

### italic

- `this italic(boolean italic)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** `null`

If set, the face read by this source declares this style instead of the one of its file.

<a id="MsdfSource-property-weight"></a>

### weight

- `this weight(FontWeight weight)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** `null`

If set, the face read by this source declares this [`FontWeight`](/reference/text/fontweight/) instead of the one of its file.

## Method details

<a id="MsdfSource-method-read"></a>

### read

`MsdfFontFace read()` 

Reads the face with `parse()`, then applies the weight and the style set on this source.

<a id="MsdfSource-method-parse"></a>

### parse

`MsdfFontFace parse()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it from `read()` on a loader thread: read the face as its file describes it.
Throw `IOException` when it cannot be read.
